title: Urubanza ruri munsi y'imiraba
intro: Umuhanuzi, wari uremerewe n'ubutumwa bwe, yafashe icyemezo cyamujyanye kure y'ubwoko bwe maze kimujyana mu kigeragezo kitunguranye. Urugendo rwe rwahinduye ibintu bikomeye, rugerageza ukwizera kwe n'ukwihangana kwe mu buryo bwimbitse cyane. Ese ushobora gusobanukirwa neza iby'iki kintu kidasanzwe ukurikije ibimenyetso byatanzwe?
clues: Umuhanuzi yoherejwe mu bwoko, ariko agenda vuba, yumva ababaye kubera kwangwa kwabo.
Urugendo rwe rwamugejeje ku nyanja, aho yinjiye mu bwato bwari buremereye cyane bushaka inzira.
Havutse inkubi y'umuyaga ikomeye, ibangamira ubwato, maze hafatwa icyemezo cyo kujugunya umuntu umwe mu bwato kugira ngo borohereze umutwaro, hashingiwe ku bufindo.
Yamizwe n'ikiremwa cyo mu nyanja, igikorwa cy'igitangaza cyagenwe n'ubushake bw'Imana.
Mu nda y'ikiremwa, yahamagaye Umwami we, yicuza kandi asingiza Allah mu mwijima.
Nyuma y'igihe cyo kwinginga cyane, yajugunywe ku nkombe y'umutarwe, afite intege nke ariko ari muzima, hanyuma agaruka asanga abantu be bari bamaze kwemera.

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
